Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001027" [decision]: At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour.  (about: Cinder, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000917": The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000846": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: billing API, Ember team, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000836": A partner asked for webhook key rotation in their security review.  (about: webhook dispatcher, partner)
- memory_id "1000831" [decision]: At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, rotating keys)
- memory_id "1000787" [decision]: Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000783": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000779": The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000626": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017, intermediate certificate)
- memory_id "1000622": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000587" [constraint]: Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000455": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, index, schema migration)
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000395": The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000226": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000224" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000175": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)

[2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys.
